The implementation permits ccReceive minting only from the configured messenger and ccSendToken burns for cross-chain transfer. Live explorer reads on 2026-09-21 returned messenger 0xdb132ebae3fcce50d6c55088f079386dcca8ff24, owner 0xb573c94260582f0715fc477928b04a2708dd36d7, operator/revoker 0x89bb23e4a82e04a253d9f11767fedf321c127799, delay 14,400 seconds, mintBudget 0, and totalSupply 28 XAUm. The verified messenger transaction history identifies LayerZero peer setup and a live LayerZero send.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The verified messenger history records LayerZero peer configuration and a successful lzSendTokenToChain transaction. The exact remote peer bytes were not needed to identify the active configured messenger.
routeChecks.caps: MTokenSide ccReceive spends the cross-chain mint budget. The live token read returned mintBudget 0 and totalSupply 28 XAUm on 2026-09-21.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The token accepts ccReceive only from messenger 0xdb132ebae3fcce50d6c55088f079386dcca8ff24. Matrixdock owner 0xb573c94260582f0715fc477928b04a2708dd36d7 can replace the messenger through the token's four-hour delayed request/effect path.

controls.capDescription: Bridge minting is constrained by the MTokenSide mint budget received through the configured messenger; the observed live budget was zero.
bypassSurfaces: The Matrixdock owner can replace the messenger and UUPS implementation after the configured four-hour delay.
LayerZero peer and validation configuration remains part of the messenger failure domain.
